notes.title: A Message from Zeitware Studios
notes.content:
[h3]Merry Christmas and happy holidays to the Zeitware community!
[/h3]
What started off as a passion project from our developer (yes singular), became the Lazarus Trials Series. Thank you to all those who decided to support us and joined the Zeitware community! 

Our current discount for trial 101 will run until [b]Dec 21 2020[/b], just in time for the holiday season. We are so excited to have started the Lazarus Trials project and are looking for ideas and suggestions for 101 and for the future titles in the series. We are always looking for more support either through advertising or feedback. That way we will be able to provide a better experience to our community.

Feel free to submit your reviews for the game. We only want honesty, because we truly want to make a special product offering that would be beneficial to groups typically overlooked by the big name studios.

Currently we are conceptualizing the next entry in The Lazarus Trials to teach things about first person shooters. What are common shooter tropes you believe new players should know?

 - Zeitware Studios
